note: A ball (radius 3 at the origin) with a GeneratedCubeMapTexture. Three big boxes sit off screen: red on the left, green on the right, blue above (the ball sees them in its sides and top; nothing is behind the camera). update NONE: nothing is drawn, the ball is black; NEXT_FRAME_ONLY: one picture is taken on the next frame and update goes back to NONE (an event, in both engines), the ball then shows the boxes; ALWAYS: a picture every frame.
gaps: measured against X_ITE 16.6.0 (Chromium 153 SwiftShader, three.js r187): main 34.0 dB, IoU 0.94; turned (camera 30 degrees round the ball) IoU 0.98 at 34.0 dB: X_ITE does not turn the picture with the camera, and neither does this body (the reflection is in camera space, the six pictures are in world axes, as X_ITE's)
the six pictures are taken with a cube camera at the origin of the first mesh of the Shape with the Shape left out; faces are 'size' pixels, linearly filtered, no mipmaps
a Background is drawn as spheres around the main camera, so the cube camera sees them from the Shape's origin, not from the main camera (not tested)
